sources_note: 綜合 TechCrunch、Digiday、Campaign Asia、Marketing Interactive、SocialBeta、36氪、新浪財經、Google Ads Blog 等過去 48 小時報道。
sources_note_en: Compiled from TechCrunch, Digiday, Campaign Asia, Marketing Interactive, SocialBeta, 36Kr, Sina Finance, Google Ads Blog and other sources within the past 48 hours.
sections: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
廣告平台 & 行銷科技
行業影響 & 品牌案例
thesis: AI 競爭升級、媒體流量重構與 Agency 版圖洗牌正在同步發生，廣告行業面臨三個層級的同時衝擊。
thesis_en: AI competition, media traffic restructuring, and agency consolidation are happening simultaneously, hitting three layers of the advertising industry at once.
thesis_note: 本週重點訊號匯聚三個層級：AI 供應鏈層（Anthropic 揭露中國 AI 蒸餾攻擊、OpenAI Astra 需求爆升致 Pro 暫停）、媒體基礎設施層（大型媒體放棄 Google SEO 模式、Instacart 引入 AI 對話購物廣告）、Agency 業務層（LVMH 不比稿轉交 Publicis、Omnicom-IPG 整合後首次 C-suite 更換）。三個層級的訊號同步出現，意味廣告業正處於一個少有的同步變革窗口。
thesis_note_en: This week's key signals converge across three layers: the AI supply chain (Anthropic exposing Chinese AI distillation attacks, OpenAI's Astra demand surge forcing Pro sign-up pause), media infrastructure (major publishers abandoning Google SEO, Instacart introducing AI conversational ad inventory), and agency operations (LVMH awarding Publicis without a pitch, first C-suite change post Omnicom-IPG merger). Three simultaneous signals across three layers indicate the advertising industry is in a rare synchronised transformation window.

items.title: Moonshot AI targets $2B annual revenue as Kimi K3 surges and Hong Kong IPO approaches
items.title_en: Moonshot AI targets $2B annual revenue as Kimi K3 surges and Hong Kong IPO approaches
items.summary: Moonshot AI 宣佈年底目標年化收入 20 億美元，Kimi K3 每日處理 3,000 億 token 流量，以 500 億美元估值融資並籌備最快年底港股上市。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI is targeting $2B in annualized revenue by year-end, with Kimi K3 processing 300B daily tokens, raising at a $50B valuation and eyeing a potential Hong Kong IPO as early as year-end.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: Kimi K3 成本遠低於美國競品，中國市場 AI 工具選型具備明顯價格優勢，值得評估。
items.why_en: Kimi K3 is significantly cheaper than US equivalents, making it worth evaluating for cost-sensitive AI tool decisions in China.
highlights: Moonshot AI 年底目標年化收入 20 億美元，Kimi K3 帶動每日 3,000 億 token 流量。
公司以 500 億美元估值進行新輪融資，香港 IPO 計劃最快年底推進。
Anthropic 同步指控 Moonshot 秘密路由 30 萬請求至 Claude 抽取訓練數據。
highlights_en: Moonshot AI is targeting $2B in annualized revenue by year-end, with Kimi K3 generating 300B daily tokens.
The company is raising at a $50B valuation with a potential Hong Kong IPO as early as year-end.
Anthropic simultaneously accused Moonshot of secretly routing 300K requests to Claude to extract training data.

items.title: DeepSeek 委任中信證券籌備科創板上市，估值達人民幣 5,000 億元
items.title_en: DeepSeek files for STAR Market IPO with CITIC Securities at RMB 500B valuation
items.summary: DeepSeek 委任中信證券籌備科創板上市，估值達人民幣 5,000 億元；前七個月資本支出逾 110 億元，API 毛利率 82.9%，創辦人重申 AGI 為終極目標。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has mandated CITIC Securities for a STAR Market IPO at a RMB 500B valuation; capex exceeded RMB 11B in the first seven months with API gross margin at 82.9%, as the founder reiterated AGI as the ultimate goal.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: DeepSeek 上市確立長期競局地位，廣告行業 AI 工具選型需持續追蹤其定價策略走向。
items.why_en: DeepSeek's IPO path cements its long-term competitive position; track how its open-source stance and pricing evolve post-listing.
highlights: DeepSeek 委任中信證券承銷科創板上市，估值達人民幣 5,000 億元。
API 毛利率達 82.9%，前七個月資本支出逾人民幣 110 億元，財務基礎穩健。
創辦人梁文鋒重申 AGI 為終極目標，開源策略短期不變。
highlights_en: DeepSeek has mandated CITIC Securities for a STAR Market IPO, targeting a RMB 500B valuation.
API gross margin stands at 82.9% with over RMB 11B in capex in the first seven months.
Founder Liang Wenfeng reiterated AGI as the ultimate goal, with the open-source strategy unchanged for now.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 再度降價，智謀與 MiniMax 股價九月累跌逾兩成
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash price cut drags Zhipu and MiniMax shares down 20%+ in September
items.summary: DeepSeek 推出 V4.1 Flash 並再度降價，智謀與 MiniMax 九月股價分別累跌約 34% 與 23%；AI API 市場進入量升價跌格局，中間層工具商商業可持續性受考驗。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash launch with another price cut sent Zhipu and MiniMax shares down roughly 34% and 23% respectively in September; the AI API market is entering a volume-up, price-down cycle that challenges the sustainability of mid-layer tool businesses.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: API 持續降價令廣告主採用 AI 工具成本門檻降低，同時考驗中間層 SaaS 工具商的存續。
items.why_en: Continued API price cuts lower the barrier for advertisers to adopt AI tools, while challenging the long-term viability of mid-layer AI SaaS businesses.
highlights: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 上線後再度降價，智謀與 MiniMax 九月股價分別累跌約 34% 與 23%。
兩家公司上半年收入保持高增長，惟模型定價主導權已轉移至 DeepSeek。
AI API 市場呈現量升價跌格局，中間層 SaaS 工具的毛利空間持續收窄。
highlights_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash launched with another price cut, pushing Zhipu and MiniMax shares down ~34% and ~23% in September.
Both companies reported strong H1 revenue growth, but pricing power has shifted decisively to DeepSeek.
The AI API market is entering a volume-up, price-down cycle that is compressing margins for mid-layer SaaS tools.

items.title: 25 Fields Medal winners sign letter condemning OpenAI for harming mathematics research
items.title_en: 25 Fields Medal winners sign letter condemning OpenAI for harming mathematics research
items.summary: 25 位菲爾茲獎得主聯署公開信批評 AI 公司危害數學研究生態，OpenAI 被指向研究者施壓刪除 Anthropic 貢獻者署名，並撤回加州理工數學活動贊助。
items.summary_en: Twenty-five Fields Medal winners signed an open letter condemning AI companies for harming the mathematics research ecosystem; OpenAI was accused of pressuring researchers to remove Anthropic contributor attribution and withdrawing sponsorship from Caltech maths events.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 公司與學術界關是惡化，品牌以 AI 研究成果作行銷宣傳時需謹慎核實來源與歸因。
items.why_en: Deteriorating relations between AI companies and academia mean brands should verify attribution carefully when using AI research achievements in marketing materials.
highlights: 25 位菲爾茲獎得主聯署公開信，指控 AI 公司以急功近利方式損害數學研究社群。
OpenAI 被指施壓研究者刪除 Anthropic 貢獻者署名，並撤回加州理工數學活動贊助。
事件持續升溫，AI 研究聲譽風險成為品牌採用 AI 技術對外宣傳時的潛在隱患。
highlights_en: Twenty-five Fields Medal winners published an open letter accusing AI companies of damaging the mathematics research community.
OpenAI was accused of pressuring researchers to remove Anthropic contributor attributions and withdrawing sponsorship from Caltech maths events.
The escalating conflict creates reputational risk for brands referencing AI research achievements in marketing communications.

items.title: YC CEO Garry Tan urges US open-weight AI labs to distill frontier models to counter China
items.title_en: YC CEO Garry Tan urges US open-weight AI labs to distill frontier models to counter China
items.summary: YC CEO Garry Tan 倡議美國建立官方蒸餾制度，允許本土開源 AI 實驗室從前沿模型提煉能力，以抗衡中國開源模型威脅，防止 AI 市場走向單一壟斷。
items.summary_en: YC CEO Garry Tan proposed that the US establish an official distillation framework allowing domestic open-weight AI labs to extract capabilities from frontier models to counter Chinese open-source threats and prevent AI market monopolisation.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 美國 AI 開源政策走向將影響中小型行銷科技工具的模型選擇成本與可用性。
items.why_en: US AI open-source policy direction will influence the model selection costs and availability for mid-market MarTech tools.
highlights: YC CEO Garry Tan 倡議美國建立官方蒸餾制度，回應中國開源模型（如 DeepSeek）的挑戰。
提案旨在防止 AI 模型市場走向少數閉源公司壟斷，維持生態多樣性。
政策走向若落地，將影響開源 AI 工具的能力上限與成本結構，對行銷科技選型有直接影響。
highlights_en: YC CEO Garry Tan proposed a US official distillation framework to respond to the challenge from Chinese open-source models like DeepSeek.
The proposal aims to prevent the AI model market from being monopolised by a handful of closed-source companies.
If enacted, the policy would influence the capability ceiling and cost structure of open-source AI tools, directly impacting MarTech tool selection.

items.title: Investigation finds Meta ran 300+ ads containing child sexual abuse imagery
items.title_en: Investigation finds Meta ran 300+ ads containing child sexual abuse imagery
items.summary: Tech Transparency Project 調查發現 Meta 在 Facebook 及 Instagram 上刊登逾 332 則含兒童性剝削影像的廣告，部分由 AI 生成，中國開發商及政府關聯廣告轉售商涉入其中。
items.summary_en: An investigation by the Tech Transparency Project found Meta ran over 332 ads containing child sexual abuse imagery on Facebook and Instagram, some AI-generated, with Chinese developers and government-affiliated ad resellers implicated.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Meta 廣告環境存在重大合規風險，廣告主應立即審查 brand safety 設定與廣告刊登位置。
items.why_en: Meta's ad environment carries significant compliance risk; advertisers should immediately review brand safety settings and ad placement controls.
highlights: 調查發現 Meta 旗下平台刊登逾 332 則含兒童性剝削影像廣告，部分由 AI 生成工具製作。
中國開發商及具政府背景的廣告轉售商被指涉入購買並投放相關廣告。
未啟用分類欄位排除的品牌廣告主，有機率出現於相關廣告旁邊，構成嚴重品牌聲譽風險。
highlights_en: Meta platforms ran over 332 ads containing child sexual abuse imagery, some produced using AI generation tools.
Chinese developers and government-affiliated ad resellers were implicated in purchasing and running these ads.
Brand advertisers without category-level exclusions risk appearing alongside such content, creating serious reputational exposure.

items.title: Instacart launches white-label AI shopping assistant for retailers, ad integration in roadmap
items.title_en: Instacart launches white-label AI shopping assistant for retailers, ad integration in roadmap
items.summary: Instacart 推出 Cart Assistant 白標 AI 購物工具供零售商嵌入自有 app，並上線 AI 助手 Clementine，廣告整合功能陸續推出；多品牌零售商 AI 聊天購物採用率升至 21%。
items.summary_en: Instacart launched Cart Assistant, a white-label AI shopping tool for retailers to embed in their own apps, alongside its own Clementine AI assistant, with ad integration features rolling out progressively; multi-brand retailer adoption of AI chat commerce has risen to 21%.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Retail Media 廣告庫存正向 AI 對話介面遷移，品牌廣告主需提前了解新購物廣告格式。
items.why_en: Retail Media ad inventory is migrating to AI conversational interfaces; brand advertisers need to understand new shopping ad formats ahead of rollout.
highlights: Instacart 推出 Cart Assistant 供零售商白標嵌入，並同步上線自家 AI 購物助手 Clementine。
廣告整合功能列入路線圖，AI 聊天購物零售商採用率已升至 21%。
Retail Media 廣告庫存正向 AI 對話購物介面遷移，傳統展示廣告格式面臨挑戰。
highlights_en: Instacart launched Cart Assistant as a white-label AI tool for retailers, alongside its own Clementine AI shopping assistant.
Ad integration is on the roadmap, with multi-brand retailer adoption of AI chat commerce rising to 21%.
Retail Media ad inventory is shifting toward AI conversational shopping interfaces, challenging traditional display ad formats.

items.title: Publishers overhauling newsrooms for post-Google era as search referral traffic collapses
items.title_en: Publishers overhauling newsrooms for post-Google era as search referral traffic collapses
items.summary: USA Today、紐約時報、華盛頓郵報等大型媒體因 Google 搜尋流量持續萎縮，大規模重組編輯架構，新增 GEO 職能，轉向通訊及 Podcast 建立直接受眾連結。
items.summary_en: Major publishers including USA Today, the New York Times, and the Washington Post are overhauling editorial structures as Google referral traffic collapses, adding GEO functions and pivoting to newsletters and podcasts for direct audience development.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 媒體流量結構正在重塑，廣告主需重估 SEO 導向媒體購買的長期效益。
items.why_en: As media traffic structures shift, advertisers should reassess the long-term ROI of SEO-driven media buys and explore GEO advertising opportunities.
highlights: USA Today、紐約時報等大型媒體正大規模重組，新增生成式搜尋最佳化（GEO）職能。
大型媒體將受眾策略從 Google 搜尋流量轉向通訊訂閱與 Podcast 的直接受眾連結。
SEO 導向媒體廣告的長期效益受到質疑，廣告主需重新評估媒體購買組合。
highlights_en: Major publishers including USA Today and the New York Times are restructuring newsrooms to add GEO (generative engine optimisation) functions.
Publishers are shifting audience strategies from Google search referrals to newsletters and podcasts for direct audience ownership.
The long-term ROI of SEO-driven media advertising is under question, prompting advertisers to reconsider their media buying mix.

items.title: 可靈 3.0 亮相 AI 廣告創新季，首推圖生影片加主體參考技術
items.title_en: Kling 3.0 debuts at AI Advertising Innovation Season with world-first image-to-video and subject-reference feature
items.summary: 可靈 3.0 於上海 AI 廣告創新季展示多模態能力，推出全球首創圖生影片加主體參考技術，業界討論 AI 後創作者核心競爭力已從執行力轉向判斷力與審美。
items.summary_en: Kling 3.0 showcased multimodal capabilities at Shanghai's AI Advertising Innovation Season, debuting a world-first image-to-video plus subject-reference feature, as the industry debated the shift in creator core competencies from execution to judgment and aesthetics.
items.why: 可靈 3.0 新技術可直接提升廣告影片製作的品牌角色一致性與製作效率。
items.why_en: Kling 3.0's new features directly improve ad video production by maintaining brand character consistency and reducing turnaround time.
highlights: 可靈 3.0「圖生影片＋主體參考」技術，可在影片生成中保持品牌角色或產品的視覺一致性。
All-in-One 多模態能力整合圖像生成、影片生成與編輯功能於單一平台。
業界人士指出，AI 工具成熟後，創作者的核心價值已從執行技能轉向判斷力與審美取向。
highlights_en: Kling 3.0's image-to-video plus subject-reference feature maintains visual consistency for brand characters or products across generated video.
The All-in-One multimodal capability integrates image generation, video generation, and editing into a single platform.
Industry voices noted that as AI tools mature, creator value has shifted from execution skills to judgment and aesthetic sensibility.

items.title: LVMH 不比稿直接將亞太媒體帳號從 WPP 轉交 Publicis
items.title_en: LVMH awards APAC media account to Publicis without a pitch, ending WPP's nine-year run
items.summary: LVMH 將亞太媒體帳號（日本除外）從 WPP 轉交 Publicis Groupe，2027 年 1 月生效，無競爭性比稿，終止 WPP 約九年的合作關是。
items.summary_en: LVMH has transferred its APAC media account (excluding Japan) from WPP to Publicis Groupe, effective January 2027, without a competitive pitch, ending WPP's approximately nine-year relationship.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 頂級廣告主不比稿換代理商，AI 整合能力已成 Holding Company 競爭核心指標。
items.why_en: A top advertiser awarding accounts without a pitch signals that AI capability and integrated services are now decisive factors in holding company competition.
highlights: LVMH 亞太媒體帳號由 WPP 直接轉交 Publicis，無需競爭性比稿，2027 年 1 月生效。
此次更替終止 WPP 與 LVMH 約九年的合作關是，涉及亞太多個主要市場。
不比稿直接委任的模式顯示大型廣告主決策愈來愈重視整合能力，而非單純比較提案。
highlights_en: LVMH transferred its APAC media account from WPP to Publicis directly, without a competitive pitch, effective January 2027.
The transition ends WPP's roughly nine-year relationship with LVMH across major APAC markets.
The no-pitch model signals that large advertisers increasingly prioritise integrated capability over proposal comparisons.

items.title: Omnicom Advertising CEO 退休，BBDO 主席接任主導整合後新局面
items.title_en: Omnicom Advertising CEO Troy Ruhanen retires, BBDO chairman Andrew Robertson takes the helm
items.summary: Omnicom Advertising CEO Troy Ruhanen 退休，BBDO Worldwide 主席 Andrew Robertson 接任，強調創意結合 AI 與數據能力，為 Omnicom-IPG 整合後首次重大領導層更替。
items.summary_en: Omnicom Advertising CEO Troy Ruhanen is retiring with BBDO Worldwide Chairman Andrew Robertson named as successor, emphasising creativity combined with AI and data capabilities — the first major leadership change following the Omnicom-IPG merger.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: Omnicom-IPG 合體後首次 C-suite 更換，創意優先訊號值得 agency pitch 策略參考。
items.why_en: The first C-suite change post Omnicom-IPG merger, with a creativity-first signal worth noting for agency pitch strategies.
highlights: Omnicom Advertising CEO Troy Ruhanen 宣告退休，BBDO Worldwide 主席 Andrew Robertson 接任。
Robertson 強調以創意能力為核心，配合 AI 與數據整合，應對 Omnicom-IPG 合併後的規模挑戰。
此為 Omnicom-IPG 整合完成後首次重大領導層更替，方向標誌性強。
highlights_en: Omnicom Advertising CEO Troy Ruhanen announced his retirement, with BBDO Worldwide Chairman Andrew Robertson named as successor.
Robertson emphasised creativity at the core, supported by AI and data integration, to address the scale challenges of the Omnicom-IPG combination.
This is the first major leadership change since the Omnicom-IPG combination closed, making it a directional signal for the group.

items.title: 雪碧冠名《說唱巔峰對決 2026》：共創加電商閉環一體化整合行銷範本
items.title_en: Sprite sponsors rap competition show with deep co-creation and e-commerce close-loop integration
items.summary: 雪碧獨家冠名愛奇藝《說唱巔峰對決 2026》，以「爆爽合伙人」身份聯動選手共創音樂推廣新品雪碧＋茶，發起 UGC 挑戰直連電商轉化漏斗。
items.summary_en: Sprite exclusively sponsored iQIYI's rap competition show 'The Rap Peak 2026' as 'Epic Partner', co-creating music content with contestants to promote the new Sprite+Tea, with UGC challenges directly linking to an e-commerce conversion funnel.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 綜藝冠名從曝光轉向共創加電商閉環，是中國 KOL 整合行銷打法的高階範本。
items.why_en: Sponsorship has evolved from brand exposure to co-creation plus e-commerce close-loop — a high-level template for integrated KOL marketing in China.
highlights: 雪碧以「爆爽合伙人」角色深度融入節目，聯動選手共創音樂推廣新品雪碧＋茶。
品牌發起 UGC 挑戰賽，將社群互動直接連結至電商轉化漏斗，形成完整閉環。
此案展示綜藝冠名從單純「品牌露出」進化至「共創品牌內容＋銷售轉化」的整合新範本。
highlights_en: Sprite integrated deeply as 'Epic Partner', co-creating music content with contestants to promote the new Sprite+Tea product.
The brand launched UGC challenges directly linked to an e-commerce conversion funnel, closing the loop from exposure to purchase.
This case demonstrates how entertainment sponsorship has evolved from logo placement to co-created brand content with direct sales conversion.

items.title: Club Med 任命 FABCOM，Grab 品牌微短劇司機戀情情節引發品牌監製邊界討論
items.title_en: Club Med appoints FABCOM for APAC media; Grab's branded microdrama driver-romance subplot stirs brand safety debate
items.summary: Club Med 任命 FABCOM 為 APAC 媒體代理商覆蓋 14 市場；Grab 首部品牌微短劇因司機乘客戀愛情節引發公眾反彈，觸發品牌監製邊界的行業討論。
items.summary_en: Club Med appointed FABCOM as APAC media agency across 14 markets; Grab's first branded microdrama sparked public backlash over a driver-passenger romance subplot, triggering an industry debate on brand editorial boundaries.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: APAC agency 版圖重組與微短劇品牌安全爭議，影響香港 digital agency 的業務開拓策略。
items.why_en: APAC agency realignment and microdrama brand safety controversies directly affect Hong Kong digital agency business development strategy.
highlights: Club Med 任命 FABCOM 為 APAC 媒體代理商，覆蓋 14 個市場；Maybank 亦選 We Are Social 擔任社媒代理。
Grab 首部品牌微短劇因司機與乘客戀愛情節引發公眾不滿，節目已修改相關場景。
此事件引發廣告業討論：品牌涉足戲劇創作時，應如何界定監製責任與品牌安全標準。
highlights_en: Club Med named FABCOM as its APAC media agency across 14 markets, while Maybank selected We Are Social as social media agency.
Grab's first branded microdrama received public backlash over a driver-passenger romance subplot and has since revised the scenes.
The incident triggered an industry debate on editorial responsibility and brand safety standards when brands venture into scripted content marketing.

items.title: Schroders Wealth Management 從渣打與 Google 引才，出任亞洲行銷及傳播主管

items.summary: 施羅德財富管理任命具渣打銀行及 Google 背景的 Jyane Quek 出任亞洲行銷及傳播主管，統籌品牌策略與客戶數位互動，反映金融行業搶奪 MarTech 人才趨勢加速。
items.summary_en: Schroders Wealth Management appointed Jyane Quek, with backgrounds spanning Standard Chartered and Google, as Head of Asia Marketing and Communications overseeing brand strategy and digital client engagement — reflecting the financial sector's intensifying competition for MarTech talent.

新職責涵蓋品牌策略、客戶數位互動及整合傳播，橫跨亞洲多個市場。

items.title: Google Ads 推出 Data Strength Uplift Metric，量化第一方數據對 ROAS 的貢獻
items.title_en: Google Ads launches Data Strength Uplift Metric to quantify first-party data impact on ROAS
items.summary: Google Ads 推出 Data Strength Uplift Metric 量化第一方數據回報；Meridian GeoX 全球正式上線支援因果地理實驗；Data Manager API 整合 IAB ECAPI 標準，平均帶來 26% ROAS 提升。
items.summary_en: Google Ads launched the Data Strength Uplift Metric to quantify first-party data ROI; Meridian GeoX reached global GA for causal geo experiments; and Data Manager API integrated IAB ECAPI standards — driving an average 26% incremental ROAS uplift.
items.why: 立即啟用 Uplift Metric，向客戶量化展示第一方數據的可測量回報，強化預算討論籌碼。
items.why_en: Enable the Uplift Metric now to show clients a quantified, measurable return on first-party data, strengthening budget conversations.
highlights: Google Ads 新推 Data Strength Uplift Metric，可在帳戶內直接量化第一方數據對廣告效益的貢獻。
Meridian GeoX 正式全球上線，支援因果地理實驗，幫助廣告主科學評估市場測試成效。
Data Manager API 整合 IAB ECAPI 標準並接入 GA 及 DV360，平均帶來 26% 增量 ROAS 提升。
highlights_en: Google Ads' new Data Strength Uplift Metric lets you quantify within your account how first-party data contributes to ad performance.
Meridian GeoX has reached global GA, enabling causal geo experiments to scientifically evaluate market test effectiveness.
Data Manager API now integrates IAB ECAPI standards with connections to GA and DV360, delivering an average 26% incremental ROAS uplift.
